sky-signal.$description: Sky Signal — Brand accent — the single chromatic punctuation in a monochrome interface. Active nav items, inline links, hashtag chips, and filled primary buttons

slate-type.$description: Slate Type — Primary text and nav labels — a cool, slightly desaturated near-black that reads softer than pure ink on the warm-white canvas

hazy-steel.$description: Hazy Steel — Secondary icons, metadata, timestamps, and muted helper text. The cool tint keeps it visually adjacent to Sky Signal without competing

whisper-border.$description: Whisper Border — Hairline dividers and card borders. The only structural line work in the system — it defines edges without adding weight

fog-surface.$description: Fog Surface — Subtle fill for hover states, secondary buttons, and search input backgrounds. Sits one step above the canvas without creating contrast drama

mist-canvas.$description: Mist Canvas — Page background — a barely-warm off-white that prevents the harshness of pure white during long reading sessions

paper.$description: Paper — Card and surface background. The single step up from the canvas that gives post cards their boundary via border, not shadow

ink.$description: Ink — Body text on cards and highest-contrast foreground. Used sparingly where maximum legibility is required

intervariable.$description: Sole typeface for all UI — navigation, post bodies, metadata, buttons, inputs. The variable axis is critical: the scale ranges from 8px timestamps to 24px tab headers, so the weight axis must flex smoothly across that range without optical hiccups. No display sizes exist — this is a feed UI, not a landing page.
